title: Keep internal source-root fields of DelegationAcceptanceEvaluation off the frontend wire
outcome:
From the Claude /review-code of tm-5gi4 phase 2, round 13, Low.

DelegationAcceptanceEvaluation.sourceRoot (root, commonDirKey, workId, claimId, generation) and sourceClaim (workId, claimId) are serialized to the frontend, and ui/src/types.ts mirrors them. The UI reads none of them. Local-only, so there is no exposure risk, but they widen the wire contract the frontend types must track.

Fix direction: keep them in the persisted evaluation record only, via a separate wire projection, or trim what the UI gets to root and workId.
